title: Advancing Multimodal LLMs by Large-Scale 3D Visual Instruction Dataset Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Multimodal LLMs using multiple-choice visual question answering (VQA) benchmarks (Ultimate3D and MMVP) to detect systematic tendencies (biases) to over-predict specific object orientations (e.g., 'front'), viewpoints (e.g., 'top'), or camera-shot distances (e.g., 'close-up') regardless of the actual image content, stemming from training dataset imbalances.
